description: This file defines the ResponseMetadata class and related functions for managing response metadata such as hidden parameters and timing metrics for LiteLLM responses in a machine learning or LLM interface project.

classes.name: ResponseMetadata
classes.description: A class that manages setting and updating response metadata including hidden parameters and timing metrics for LiteLLM responses.

methods.name: __init__(self, result: Any)
methods.description: Initializes the ResponseMetadata object with a result and captures hidden parameters.

methods.name: bool supports_response_time(self)
methods.description: Checks whether the response type supports timing metrics.

methods.name: None set_hidden_params( self, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObject, model: Optional[str], kwargs: dict )
methods.description: Sets hidden parameters on the response, including call IDs, API base, model ID, cost, and headers.

methods.name: None _update_hidden_params(self, new_params: dict)
methods.description: Updates the hidden parameters dictionary or object with new values.

methods.name: Optional[Any] _get_value_from_hidden_params(self, key: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a value from hidden parameters, handling both dict and HiddenParams object.

methods.name: None set_timing_metrics( self, start_time: datetime.datetime, end_time: datetime.datetime, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObject, )
methods.description: Calculates and sets response timing metrics and overhead times.

methods.name: None apply(self)
methods.description: Applies the accumulated metadata to the result object.

methods.name: None update_response_metadata( result: Any, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObject, model: Optional[str], kwargs: dict, start_time: datetime.datetime, end_time: datetime.datetime, )

ctags.signature: ( self, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObject, model: Optional[str], kwargs: dict )

ctags.name: set_timing_metrics
ctags.signature: ( self, start_time: datetime.datetime, end_time: datetime.datetime, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObject, )

ctags.name: update_response_metadata
ctags.signature: ( result: Any, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObject, model: Optional[str], kwargs: dict, start_time: datetime.datetime, end_time: datetime.datetime, )
